How a low-pass filter works

By the Signals Weekly team

Share this page

A low-pass filter lets slow changes through and smooths fast ones. Read the guide to RC circuits first. Also see the reference tables.

Buy the best oscilloscope today, limited offer!

The cut-off frequency

The cut-off is where the output falls to 70.7% of the input, so fc = 1 / (2πRC). Read aloud as f sub c.

The capacitor is the memory of the circuit.

fc = 1 / (2 * pi * R * C)
print(round(fc, 1))
